claims.scope: This causes legitimate trades to fail with a misleading error, damaging user experience and market efficiency.

preconditions.text: A limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed in _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.; The matched base amount is a power-of-two value 2^k.; The matched quote amount is any value less than 2^k (e.g., base = 256, quote in 1..255).; The two matched amounts have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., 40 & 21 = 0).
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The zero-cost trade check must reject only trades where one side receives tokens without sending any, not legitimate trades whose amounts have disjoint bits.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: This causes legitimate trades to fail with a misleading error, damaging user experience and market efficiency.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities at the checkpoint before the zero-cost trade check.
The disjoint-bit condition is represented as a report-grounded Boolean because the report gives only examples (40 & 21 = 0) and no general numeric definition.

limitations: The zero-cost trade check's internal implementation is not formalized; only the report-stated observable outcome is represented.
The misleading error is represented as a Boolean outcome rather than a specific error code or message.
Caller identity and authorization for triggering limit order matching are not stated by the report and are not encoded.
